{{Quote|Currently only a single Jedi can be appointed Grand Master at any one time. I am quite happy to hold the title, so I trust you younger ones will indulge me if I don't announce plans to relinquish it anytime soon.|Fae Coven|<ref name="TJP" />}}
'''Fae Coven''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jenet/Legends|Jenet]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and the [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] following the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]], serving until her [[Death/Legends|death]] sometime after [[896 BBY/Legends|896 BBY]]. The [[Master of the Order/Legends|Master of the Order]], Coven was usually stationed at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] proceeding the Reformations. Among her many contributions to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Order during her years of service was her [[Author/Legends|authorship]] of the Temple guidebook titled, ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''. With several contribution authors, Master Coven's work would be printed in three editions and copies were passed down from Master to [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] for several generations.

==Biography==
{{Quote|As a Jedi, you must be faithful to the spirit of the Code. Every day you must ask yourself: Do I understand it?|Fae Coven|<ref name="TJP" />}}
A pink-skinned Jenet Jedi, Coven had been serving the Jedi Order for forty some years before joining in the ferocious [[New Sith Wars]]. Helping to reorganize the [[Jedi academy]] following the defeat of the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]], Coven was elected as the Grand Master that would lead the Order and the reborn [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] into its [[Golden Age of the Old Republic|Golden Age]]. Because of inconsistencies in training caused by the war, Coven decided to create a guidebook that set all of the Order's regulations in plain spoken [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] that was available to all Jedi.<ref name="TJP" />

In her guidebook, Coven typically began each section, detailing regulations set in place or certain ceremonies to be observed. With the assistance of several fellow Masters, Coven's dream came to fruition and ''The Jedi Path'' became a facet in the Order's traditional readings.<ref name="TJP" />

While her date of death is lost to history, one of her future successors, a student of the Force known as [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], wrote in a volume of her guidebook that he remembered her from his years as an [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiate]] at the academy. This places her death sometime after the year [[896 BBY/Legends|896 BBY]].<ref name="TJP" />
